profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Ex-Bank Of America | Ex-Deloitte
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable distributed systems and cloud-native applications for global financial institutions including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Deloitte. Expertise in Java, Spring Boot, React, microservices, event-driven architectures, and enterprise workflow platforms. Proven ability to modernize legacy systems, lead complex technical initiatives, and deliver high-performance solutions that improve operational efficiency. Experienced leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering productivity and software delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Delivered innovative solutions for client onboarding and KYC processes, streamlining workflows and enhancing operational efficiency.
• Designed and implemented three-tier architecture solutions supporting front-office teams, reducing manual tasks and accelerating processes.
• Led development of critical KYC functionality: simplified client document validation, reduced duplicate records, and resolved status ambiguity for bankers.
• Built REST API and GraphQL services for seamless system integration, improving scalability and data accuracy.
•  Enhanced React/Redux JavaScript applications, modularizing components and optimizing state management for better UI performance and development efficiency.
•  Implemented event-driven communication using Kafka and RabbitMQ, enabling scalable asynchronous workflows.
•  Leveraged expertise in Java Spring Framework, React/Angular, SQL/Oracle, deploying applications on internal Cloud (PaaS) platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · GraphQL · RESTful WebServices · Software Design · SQL · TypeScript · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Angular

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
• In my capacity as a Software Developer at Bank of America, I collaborated closely with clients in the to redesign their trade surveillance and monitoring application. 
• My commitment to addressing client needs ensured a seamless experience for managing extensive enterprise data. 
• Employing a robust three-tier architecture, I strategically utilized Angular 11 for frontend development, Java (Spring Boot 2) for backend, and Oracle DB for efficient database management, thereby optimizing the application's scalability. 
• My contributions extended to the development of technology roadmaps for API services, involving collaborative efforts with both internal and external providers to enhance and align services with evolving requirements. 
• My dedication to reliability and stability is underscored by the creation of comprehensive JUnit testing classes. 
• In the domain of presentation layer development, I expertly employed JavaScript, Angular, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, and Angular Material components. Leveraging Spring Batch, I proficiently implemented batch jobs for processing voluminous data from diverse sources. 
• My role also encompassed mentoring junior developers and fostering seamless collaboration with offshore teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · RESTful WebServices · Software Design · Angular · SQL · TypeScript

positions.title: Solutions Analyst
positions.description: Designed and implemented enterprise-grade applications to streamline data ingestion into centralized repositories, enabling advanced analytics. Collaborated with diverse clients to gather requirements and deliver distributed, multi-tier architecture solutions. Developed RESTful microservices using Spring Boot for seamless AWS integrations, leveraging Lambda and DynamoDB to process over one million records efficiently. Optimized scalability with AWS RDS and ensured system reliability using Hystrix and Feign for fault-tolerant microservices. Employed CloudWatch for real-time monitoring and optimization. Delivered end-to-end solutions within Agile frameworks, achieving timely execution and quality outcomes while driving innovation in cloud-based enterprise systems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Modernized a ticketing system into a single-page web app using JavaScript, SQL, HTML5, CSS, and Bootstrap. Collaborated in Agile teams, managing deployments, testing, debugging, and enhancing user experiences.

projects.title: AI Powered Fitness Agent
projects.description:
Developed an AI-powered Fitness Tracking Application using a full-stack microservice architecture.

Designed backend services with Spring Boot, Eureka, API Gateway, Config Server, and RabbitMQ for event-driven communication, secured via Keycloak OAuth2.

Built a React-based UI and integrated Google Gemini API for intelligent recommendations. Used MySQL for user/activity data and MongoDB to persist AI insights, showcasing scalable, enterprise-grade architecture.

projects.title: Health Care Premium Prediction - Machine Learning Project
projects.description:
A machine learning-based project that predicts health care premium costs based on various user-provided criteria. This project demonstrates data preprocessing, regression modeling, and deployment with a web-based interface using Streamlit.

This project predicts health care premiums by processing Excel data with Pandas, cleaning and scaling features using MinMaxScaler, and training regression models via Scikit-learn. It achieves up to 90% accuracy and includes a Streamlit-based user interface, fully deployed on Streamlit Cloud for real-time user interaction and predictions.
